answer: Random beacon spot-checks and a compute heartbeat stop fake identities. Each identity locks 20 coins and sends a heartbeat pulse hourly proving work. Each epoch a beacon picks 5% to re-prove within 10 minutes; a saffron badge marks checked, and a missed proof forfeits the lock. Forging 1,000 identities locks 20,000 coins and needs 1,000 pulses hourly, while one honest identity pays 20 coins, keeps its jade seal, and earns undiluted rewards.
